tips.text: Poke with Seismic Shard when the enemy steps up to last-hit. It slowed them and gives you their lost Move Speed, so you can walk up and trade.
Use Ground Slam in a trade against enemies who rely on basic attacks. It cuts their Attack Speed for a few seconds.
Hit with Thunderclap to start a trade. It gives bonus range and extra damage, and your next attacks keep hitting in a cone.
Don't cast Seismic Shard or Ground Slam while Thunderclap's empowered attack is winding up. You can't cast them until it lands.
Fight while Granite Shield is up. It makes your Thunderclap armor much bigger, so back off and let it recharge between trades.
Use Unstoppable Force to close in on a target or to start a fight. Nothing can stop the dash, and it knocks up everyone you land on.
Aim Unstoppable Force at where the enemy will be. It travels in a line and the hit area is limited, so a good aim matters.

combos.name: Flash Unstoppable Force
combos.when: You need to engage a backline target that expects to be out of your ultimate range.
combos.text: Flash toward the enemy and cast the ultimate right away so the knock-up lands from a spot they didn't expect. Aim it at the middle of the group.

combos.name: Fast ultimate through a wall
combos.when: A thin wall sits between you and the enemies, such as a jungle wall or a river wall.
combos.text: Aim the ultimate at the middle of the wall so you end up on the far side. The dash gets much faster, so it is harder to dodge.

tips.text: Use Seismic Shard when Aatrox walks up to trade; the slow cuts how well he can line up his attacks, and you gain speed.
Cast Ground Slam when Aatrox is in melee range; it cuts his Attack Speed, so he hits you less often while he tries to heal.
Trade while Granite Shield is up, because Thunderclap gives much more Armor then. Back off and let the shield recharge between fights.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Aatrox commits to a fight. It can't be stopped once started, so use it to knock him up.
Keep Granite Shield up before Akali engages; it triples the Armor from Thunderclap and makes her physical-looking burst far weaker.
Hit Akali with Seismic Shard when she dashes in or tries to leave. She is slowed and you gain Move Speed to chase her.
Use Ground Slam as she jumps on you. It cuts her Attack Speed, so her follow-up attacks hurt less.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Akali commits. It cannot be stopped mid-dash and it knocks her up.
Don't chase her into Twilight Shroud. You can't see her inside, so wait outside or poke the smoke with area abilities.

comboRefs.note: Flash into Unstoppable Force can catch Akali off guard and knock her up before she can dash away.

tips.text: Hit Ambessa with Seismic Shard when she walks up; she is slowed and you gain speed, so you can pick the trade.
Use Ground Slam when she commits to a fight; her attacks slow down and her damage comes mostly from attacks and Medarda Maxim.
Keep Granite Shield up before trading, since Thunderclap gives much more Armor while it is active.
Save Unstoppable Force for when she dives you or tries to run; the dash can't be stopped by crowd control.
Walk at Anivia in a way that dodges Flash Frost; the ice is a wide, slow-moving missile that can be sidestepped, and its stun is nasty if you get caught.
Use Seismic Shard on Anivia to slow her and speed yourself up so you can close the gap to her.
Hold Unstoppable Force for when Anivia is within reach; the dash can't be deterred, so her wall won't stop you.
Hit Anivia with Ground Slam when you reach her; it cuts her Attack Speed and does heavy damage when you have armor.
Her egg is easy to hurt early on; after Rebirth triggers, kill it quickly or wait for her to come back at full health.
Hit Aurora with Seismic Shard when she walks up to trade; she is slowed and you gain speed to close the gap.
Use Ground Slam when she commits to an all-in; it cuts her Attack Speed, which weakens her basic attack trades.
Save Unstoppable Force for after she shows her hop. It can't be stopped mid-dash, so use it to knock her up and kill her.
Trade when Granite Shield is up; it triples the Armor from Thunderclap, so her basic attacks hurt less.
Don't chase when Aurora turns invisible with Across the Veil; wait and aim your next spell where she appears.
Use Ground Slam when Briar is in Blood Frenzy; it cuts her Attack Speed so her fast hits and healing drop.
Hit Briar with Seismic Shard as she closes in; she is slowed and you gain Move Speed to walk away from her.
Keep Granite Shield up before she jumps on you; it triples the Armor from Thunderclap, so her physical damage hurts less.
Use Unstoppable Force when Briar commits to a fight, since the dash can't be stopped by crowd control. It knocks her up at the end.
Use Ground Slam when Camille runs in to trade; it cuts her Attack Speed and her fights get weaker.
Hit Camille with Seismic Shard when she dashes in or tries to leave; she is slowed and you gain Move Speed.
Keep Granite Shield up before you fight; it makes the armor from Thunderclap much bigger against her physical damage.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Camille commits to a dive or trade; it dashes without being stopped and knocks her up.
If Camille traps you with The Hextech Ultimatum, fight inside it with Ground Slam and Thunderclap; you can't leave, so make her trade costly.

comboRefs.note: Camille's Hextech Ultimatum locks one target, so a Flash ultimate can still knock up her team.

tips.text: Keep poking with Seismic Shard; Cho'Gath cannot dodge it and you get faster while he is slowed.
Watch the smoke cloud from Rupture and step out of it before it lands.
Stay outside his short Feral Scream range when you need your spells, or you will be silenced.
Use Ground Slam when Cho'Gath attacks with Vorpal Spikes; it cuts his Attack Speed and his trade.
Deny Cho'Gath minion kills when you can; each Feast stack makes him bigger and tankier.
Hit Darius with Seismic Shard when he walks up; he is slowed and you gain move speed to walk away from his pull.
Use Ground Slam when Darius swings at you; it cuts his Attack Speed and weakens his trades.
Trade right after Darius uses Apprehend; he is easier to poke while it is on cooldown.
Let your Granite Shield recharge before the next fight; it boosts the Armor from Thunderclap against his physical damage.
Save Unstoppable Force to knock Darius up when he commits. You dash without being pushed off by his crowd control.
Use Seismic Shard on Mundo to slow him and speed yourself up. You can then walk away from his Infected Bonesaw fights.
Mundo's Goes Where He Pleases resists the first knock up. Do not spend Unstoppable Force on him until it is used.
Step on his dropped canister to destroy it. That denies his heal and keeps his passive on cooldown.
Use Ground Slam when Mundo walks in to hit you with Blunt Force Trauma. It cuts his Attack Speed and blunts his trade.
Take his Heart Zapper trade seriously. Back out of its range while it charges, or he heals the damage you deal to him.
Cast Seismic Shard on Fiora when she walks up or backs off; it slows her and gives you extra Move Speed to chase or leave.
Use Ground Slam when Fiora commits to a trade; it cuts her Attack Speed, which weakens her fast attacks.
Do not start a fight by locking Fiora down with Unstoppable Force while Riposte is ready; she can turn the knock up into a stun on you.
Wait for Fiora to spend Riposte, then use Unstoppable Force to land the knock up safely.
Keep Granite Shield up before a trade; Thunderclap then gives much more Armor against her physical damage.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Gangplank cannot cleanse it; Remove Scurvy clears the knock up, so bait it out first.
Use Seismic Shard on Gangplank to slow him and gain speed, then walk up and trade with Thunderclap.
Stay out of the area around his Powder Keg, since an explosion slows you and hurts. Step out of the blast before he shoots it.
Cast Ground Slam when Gangplank is in range; it cuts his Attack Speed, which hurts his Trial by Fire hits and his trades.
Use Seismic Shard on Garen to slow him and run faster yourself; it is a safe way to start a trade from long range.
Garen's Decisive Strike removes slows from him, so do not count on Seismic Shard to hold him once he has used it.
Cast Ground Slam when Garen starts Judgment; it cuts his Attack Speed, so his spins hurt less.
Trade when Granite Shield is up; Thunderclap gives you much more Armor then, which blunts Garen's physical damage.
Garen is silenced by nothing you have, so stay out of reach when Decisive Strike is ready; his silence stops your spells.
Hit Garen with Unstoppable Force when you fight together with your team; the knock up gives allies time to burst him.
Gnar outranges you as mini. Hit him with Seismic Shard when he steps up to last-hit, and use the speed it gives you to close in.
Use Ground Slam when Gnar goes for a trade. It cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his mini-form fighting and the attack-speed boost from Hop.
Trade with Thunderclap while Granite Shield is up. Your Armor is much higher then, and the empowered hit also has extra reach.
Stay away from walls when Gnar turns Mega, because GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into terrain.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Gnar is Mega or has just used his stun. At level 6 it knocks him up and the dash can't be stopped.
Use Seismic Shard on Gragas when he walks up, then chase with the speed it gives you. It slows him, so he can't easily roll away.
Cast Ground Slam before Gragas hits you with an empowered attack. It cuts his Attack Speed and hurts him more as you stack Armor.
Keep Granite Shield up before you trade; it makes Thunderclap give you much more Armor. Back off briefly so it recharges after a fight.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Gragas has used Body Slam. You dash without being stopped, and the knock up sets up a kill.

comboRefs.note: Flash into Unstoppable Force gives a surprise engage on Gragas, who has no dash that avoids it.

tips.text: Use Seismic Shard on Gwen when she tries to close in or leave; she is slowed and you gain Move Speed.
Gwen's attacks lean on Attack Speed, so use Ground Slam when she commits to a trade to cut her damage.
Don't waste Unstoppable Force while Hallowed Mist is up; she can't be targeted from outside it. Wait until she leaves the mist, then dash in.
Gwen's damage is magic, so Granite Shield and armor won't help much against it; trade carefully when she has her stacks.
Use Thunderclap for a burst of damage when she steps up to attack you, and keep hitting while it lasts.
Use Unstoppable Force to dash onto Heimerdinger when he is out of position; the dash can't be stopped by crowd control, and he is knocked up on arrival.
Hit Heimerdinger with Seismic Shard to close the gap; it slows him and speeds you up, so you can reach him before his turrets matter.
Trade with Thunderclap and Ground Slam when you are next to him, away from his turrets.
Let Granite Shield refill before you walk up. Thunderclap gives far more Armor while the shield is up.

comboRefs.note: Flash into Unstoppable Force lets Malphite reach Heimerdinger's turrets and him from an unexpected spot.

tips.text: Stay away from Tentacles when you trade. Illaoi fights far better near them, so poke her with Seismic Shard from range and leave when they appear.
Use Ground Slam when Illaoi jumps in with Harsh Lesson; her Attack Speed drops and her trade gets weaker.
Seismic Shard slows Illaoi and speeds you up. Cast it to walk away when she pulls out your spirit and tries to chase.
Hold Unstoppable Force for when Illaoi commits to a fight; it knocks her up and the dash can't be stopped.
Keep Granite Shield up before a trade by not taking damage first; it triples the armor from Thunderclap and blunts her physical hits.
Hold Ground Slam until Irelia dashes in; it cuts her Attack Speed, which her Ionian Fervor stacks depend on.
Do not waste Unstoppable Force on Defiant Dance; wait until she finishes and is open to a knock up.
Fight her when her Ionian Fervor stacks have run out; she is weakest then.
Fight her away from the minion wave, where Bladesurge has fewer targets to dash through.
Use Seismic Shard on her when she tries to leave; the slow gives you speed to chase.
Hold Seismic Shard for when Jax leaps onto you; the slow stops him from running you down.
Do not attack while Jax is in Counter Strike; wait until his stance ends and the stun is gone, then hit him.
Use Ground Slam when Jax starts hitting you; it cuts his Attack Speed, which he depends on to deal damage.
Trade in short bursts and back off; a long fight lets Jax build Attack Speed.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Jax has used Counter Strike and Leap Strike, so he cannot escape or dodge the follow-up.
Hit Jayce with Seismic Shard when he steps up to trade; the slow makes it hard for him to leap away, and you gain the speed.
Use Ground Slam when Jayce attacks you up close; it cuts his Attack Speed and hurts his Hyper Charge burst.
Fight while Granite Shield is up. It triples the Armor from Thunderclap, so Jayce's physical hits do less.
Play around his poke early and avoid taking Shock Blast hits for free. Trade back only once he has used it.
Use Unstoppable Force to dash onto Jayce when he is in range. He can't stop it, and it knocks him up.
Walk up and hit K'Sante with Seismic Shard when he steps forward; it slows him and gives you extra speed to stay on him.
Use Ground Slam when K'Sante runs in to fight; it cuts his Attack Speed and hurts more as you stack Armor.
Fight with Granite Shield up, since Thunderclap then gives much more Armor. Back off to let it recharge after a trade.
Save Unstoppable Force to knock K'Sante up when he commits, or to join a fight. Its dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Fight Kayle early, while Divine Ascent has not yet given her range. Walk up and trade with Thunderclap.
Use Seismic Shard to chase Kayle. She is fragile, and the slow gives you extra Move Speed.
Ground Slam cuts her Attack Speed, which weakens her stacking attacks. Use it when she trades with you.
After level 6, Kayle outranges you, so stay away from her and look for a way in with Unstoppable Force.
If Kayle uses Divine Judgment, wait out the invulnerability. You can still slow her, so hit her once it ends.
Use Seismic Shard on Kennen when he walks up to trade; it slows him and gives you extra Move Speed to chase or step away.
Hit Kennen with Ground Slam when he tries to fight you; his Attack Speed drops, so his trade with Attack Speed from Lightning Rush is weaker.
Kennen is fragile, so fight him once Unstoppable Force is ready. Dash onto him and he is knocked up with nowhere to go.
Stay out of his poke range while Granite Shield is down. Let it recharge before you step up to trade.
Trade with Thunderclap while Granite Shield is up; your Armor is much higher then, which helps in longer auto-attack trades.
Hit Kled with Ground Slam right before he lands his fourth attack; it cuts his Attack Speed, so Violent Tendencies loses much of its burst.
Use Seismic Shard on Kled when he runs at you; it leaves him slowed and gives you extra Move Speed to walk away or chase.
Trade when Granite Shield is up; it makes Thunderclap give far more Armor against Kled's physical damage.
Once Kled loses Skaarl, he has to fight to regain courage. Keep pressing him with Seismic Shard so he cannot easily remount.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Kled commits with Jousting or Chaaaaaaaarge!!!; it cannot be stopped by crowd control and knocks him up.
Use Seismic Shard to slow Mordekaiser when he steps up, then trade with Thunderclap while you are faster.
Cast Ground Slam when Mordekaiser attacks you; it cuts his Attack Speed, so his empowered hits land less often.
Keep Granite Shield up before a trade by staying out of poke; Thunderclap gives much more Armor while it is active.
Do not fight him in a long drawn-out trade; his Darkness Rise aura grows deadly once he lands three hits. Trade in short bursts and step away.
Save Unstoppable Force for a gap-close or escape; it cannot be stopped by crowd control. Be ready for Death's Grasp pulling you back.
Use Ground Slam when Naafiri runs in; her attack damage is physical and the attack speed cut weakens her trade and her Packmates.
Keep Granite Shield up before a trade; it triples the Armor from Thunderclap, which helps against her physical damage.
Hit Naafiri with Seismic Shard to slow her and get away or chase; you also gain Move Speed.
Hold Unstoppable Force for when she commits to a dive; the dash cannot be stopped and it knocks up everyone it lands on.
Poke Nasus with Seismic Shard when he walks up to last-hit; the slow makes him miss his Siphoning Strike farm and you gain speed.
Use Ground Slam when Nasus goes for an attack; it cuts his Attack Speed, so his trades hurt less.
Keep Granite Shield up before you trade. It makes Thunderclap give far more Armor against his physical damage.
Trade hard early, before Nasus has stacked Siphoning Strike. Use Thunderclap and then keep attacking him.
Do not fight inside Fury of the Sands. Back off and use Unstoppable Force only when you can kill him.
Hit Olaf with Seismic Shard when he walks up for the axe; the slow keeps him away from it.
Stay out of a straight line with Olaf when he has Undertow ready; sidestep it to avoid the slow and the Armor loss.
Use Ground Slam when Olaf closes in; it cuts his Attack Speed, which he relies on for his damage.
Wait until Olaf uses Ragnarok before committing Unstoppable Force; he is immune to the knock up while it lasts.
Don't fight Olaf at low health for long; he gets stronger the more damage he has taken, so back off instead of chasing him.
Stay away from walls when Ornn has Searing Charge ready; if he rams terrain next to you, you get knocked up and stunned.
Hit Ornn with Seismic Shard when he walks up to trade. It slows him and speeds you up, so you can pick the fight or walk away.
Use Ground Slam when Ornn attacks you. It cuts his Attack Speed, and his Volcanic Rupture and Searing Charge are his only other ways to damage you in a trade.
Keep Granite Shield up before you step in. It makes Thunderclap's armor much bigger, so Ornn's trades hurt less.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture; its pillar blocks the lane and you can get stuck behind it. Don't dash with Unstoppable Force into a spot he is about to wall.
Cast Ground Slam when Pantheon commits to a fight; it cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his attacks and the Shield Vault follow-up hits.
Use Seismic Shard on Pantheon as he leaves a trade; he is slowed and you gain Move Speed to chase or walk away.
Do not hit Pantheon from the front while he channels Aegis Assault; he takes no damage from that direction. Wait it out or step around behind him.
Keep Granite Shield recharged by staying out of his poke; Thunderclap gives much more Armor while the shield is up, which blunts his physical damage.
When Grand Starfall is announced, move out of the target area, or save Unstoppable Force to land on him when he arrives.
Use Ground Slam when Quinn commits to attacking you; it cuts her Attack Speed and blunts her trades.
Hit Quinn with Seismic Shard to slow her and gain Move Speed, then walk up and trade or chase.
Use Unstoppable Force at level 6 to knock her up when she is low; she cannot escape once you land.
Let Granite Shield recharge before you trade; it makes Thunderclap give you much more Armor against her physical damage.
Use Ground Slam when Renekton dives onto you; it cuts his Attack Speed and weakens his follow-up hits.
Hit Renekton with Seismic Shard when he walks up; he is slowed and you gain Move Speed to walk away from his dash.
Keep Granite Shield up before trading; it triples the Armor from Thunderclap, which helps against his physical damage.
Trade with Seismic Shard from range while his Fury is low; he cannot punish you easily until he fights and builds Fury.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Renekton commits to a fight; the dash cannot be stopped by crowd control and knocks him up.
Use Ground Slam when Riven dives in to trade; it cuts her Attack Speed and hits harder the more Armor you have.
Hit Riven with Seismic Shard to slow her, then walk away; the speed you steal helps you leave her range.
Trade while Granite Shield is up, because Thunderclap gives far more Armor then, and all of Riven's damage is physical.
Hold Unstoppable Force until Riven has spent her dashes and stun. Her Valor shield is short, so strike when it has worn off.
Stay out of Ki Burst range when you can; being stunned lets her finish her combo.

comboRefs.note: Flash into Unstoppable Force can land a knock-up on Riven even when she thinks she is out of range.

tips.text: Hit Rumble with Seismic Shard to slow him, then walk up and trade; you also gain Move Speed from the steal.
Use Ground Slam when Rumble starts hitting you with attacks. It cuts his Attack Speed, which matters most when he is Overheated.
Rumble deals mostly magic damage, so Granite Shield is only a small buffer. Let it recharge between trades by staying out of his range.
When Rumble overheats and cannot cast, dash in with Unstoppable Force and fight him.
Start your Thunderclap trade while your shield is up. Your bonus Armor is much higher then, so his attacks hurt less.
Use Seismic Shard on Sett when he walks up to trade; the slow gives you speed to close in or to walk away.
Cast Ground Slam when Sett starts punching. It cuts his Attack Speed, and your Armor makes it hit harder.
Let Granite Shield refill before you trade. Thunderclap gives much more Armor while the shield is up, so don't trade when it is broken.
Sett's Haymaker turns damage he takes into a shield. Poke him with Seismic Shard from range instead of trading blows, so he has little to store.
Aim Unstoppable Force at Sett once he is committed to a fight. He can't dodge it by being slowed or pulled, and it knocks him up.

comboRefs.note: Sett's Show Stopper is a grab, so a faster, harder-to-dodge Unstoppable Force dash helps Malphite engage.

tips.text: Use Seismic Shard on Shen when he walks up to trade; it slows him and gives you Move Speed to walk away or chase.
Cast Ground Slam when Shen starts hitting you with his empowered attacks; it cuts his Attack Speed and his damage.
Trade while Granite Shield is up; Thunderclap gives much more Armor then, so Shen's attacks hurt less.
Look out for Shen's global teleport at level 6. Do not chase a hurt Shen if his allies could shield him and arrive.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Shen is committed to a dash or fight. Once you start the dash, crowd control cannot stop you.
Use Seismic Shard on Singed when he comes close. You gain speed from his slow and can chase him down.
Stay out of Mega Adhesive when Singed throws it. Singed can Fling you into it and you will be rooted.
Use Ground Slam when Singed is on top of you. It deals good damage and weakens his attacks.
Do not chase Singed through his Poison Trail. Fight him away from it.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Singed is stuck or hurt. Nothing stops the dash once it starts.
Stay out of Sion's charge line while he winds up Decimating Smash. Step sideways out of the line before he lets go, because a full charge stuns.
Use Seismic Shard on Sion to slow him and gain speed, which makes his charged Decimating Smash harder to land.
Trade with Thunderclap and Ground Slam while your Granite Shield is up. Ground Slam cuts his Attack Speed, so his Soul Furnace trades go worse.
Keep Unstoppable Force for when Sion is stunned or slowed, or for a kill. Don't fight him right after he dies, since Glory in Death makes him hit hard.
Use Seismic Shard to slow Tahm Kench when he walks up to trade; you also gain Move Speed to chase or leave.
Cast Ground Slam when Tahm Kench trades with you; it cuts his Attack Speed so his stacks build slower.
Hit Tahm Kench with Thunderclap's empowered attack while your Granite Shield is up, since your Armor is far higher then.
Do not rely on Unstoppable Force to dodge Abyssal Dive's knock up; it is a dash, so cast it before he lands, or hit him after.
Trade in short bursts. Tahm Kench stores damage with Thick Skin and heals it back if you stop hitting him, so keep pressure on or burst him down.
Walk up to Teemo with Seismic Shard to slow him and gain Move Speed. Then close in before his Toxic Shot wears you down.
Use Ground Slam when Teemo is in range. It cuts his Attack Speed, so his Toxic Shot poison is applied less often.
Ward the bushes, since Teemo can hide in them while moving with Guerrilla Warfare. Walk around spots where a stealthed Noxious Trap could be.
Use Unstoppable Force to jump on Teemo when he is chasing a wave or standing still. Blinding Dart can't stop the dash.
Use Ground Slam when Tryndamere attacks you; it cuts his Attack Speed and blunts his damage.
Harass with Seismic Shard so Tryndamere can't build Fury and heal with Bloodlust.
Don't spend Unstoppable Force on a Tryndamere who still has Undying Rage; wait until it is used.
Keep Granite Shield recharged between trades; it strengthens your Armor through Thunderclap.
Use Seismic Shard on Urgot to slow him and run you faster, then close in for a trade.
Cast Ground Slam when Urgot is close; it cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his leg shots.
Step aside from Corrosive Charge; it explodes after a brief delay, so move before it lands.
Watch for Disdain; it stuns the first champion hit and Urgot gets a shield, so do not trade into it.
Stay above the low-health line when Fear Beyond Death hits you, or Urgot can drag you in and kill you.
Use Seismic Shard on Varus to slow him and speed yourself up, then walk in and trade before he can set up his long-range shots.
Cast Ground Slam when Varus trades with his basic attacks. It cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his Blight stacks.
Stay out of the long reach of Piercing Arrow. If you stand far away, he can snipe you for free, so walk up to him with Seismic Shard.
Use Unstoppable Force on Varus when he is charging Piercing Arrow or has used his escape. The dash can't be stopped by crowd control.
Let Granite Shield refill between trades. It makes Thunderclap give you much more Armor against his physical damage.
Hit Vayne with Seismic Shard early and often; she is slowed and you gain Move Speed to run her down.
Use Ground Slam when Vayne is about to trade; it cuts her Attack Speed, which weakens her Silver Bolts rhythm.
Keep Granite Shield up before you step in; it makes Thunderclap give you much more Armor against her attacks.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready; being pinned means a stun and big damage.
At level 6, use Unstoppable Force to dash onto Vayne; it can't be stopped by Condemn's knockback and it knocks her up.
Poke Vladimir with Seismic Shard when he walks up to last-hit. It slows him and gives you extra Move Speed.
Use Ground Slam when Vladimir trades with you; it cuts his Attack Speed and damages him.
Hold Unstoppable Force until Sanguine Pool is on cooldown, or he can become untargetable and avoid it.
Stay out of the pool's area while Vladimir is in it, since it slows you and damages you.
Fight him before Hemoplague bursts; that burst heals him.
Use Seismic Shard on Volibear as he runs at you; he is slowed and you gain his lost speed, so you can walk away from his charge.
Cast Ground Slam when Volibear commits to a fight; it cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his attack-based damage.
Trade while Granite Shield is up; Thunderclap gives much more Armor then, which makes Volibear's physical hits weaker.
Keep your distance from his Thundering Smash; if he reaches you, he leaps onto you and stuns you. Step back when he glows.
Use Unstoppable Force to knock Volibear up when he is low on health, then follow up with your other abilities.
Use Seismic Shard to slow Xin Zhao when he walks up. It also gives you speed to get away from his combo.
Use Ground Slam when Xin Zhao charges in. It cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his Three Talon Strike and the attacks he lands with it.
Keep Granite Shield up by staying out of poke. Your Thunderclap armor is triple while it lasts, so Xin Zhao's attacks do much less.
Do not stand in a line with Xin Zhao's Wind Becomes Lightning. Getting hit slows you and marks you as Challenged.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Xin Zhao has used his charge. Nothing stops the dash, and the knock up lets your team finish him.
Use Seismic Shard on Yasuo when he walks up to last-hit; it slows him and gives you speed to follow up.
Cast Ground Slam when Yasuo commits to a trade; it cuts his Attack Speed, which weakens his basic attacks.
Hold Unstoppable Force for when Yasuo is close. Its knock up lets him use Last Breath, so be ready for allies to join the fight.
Trade with Thunderclap while Granite Shield is up; your armor is much higher then, so Yasuo's attacks hurt less.
Use Unstoppable Force on Yone when he commits to a fight; the dash can't be stopped by crowd control, and it knocks him up.
Cast Ground Slam when Yone is about to hit you; it cuts his Attack Speed and he relies on attacks to trade.
Hit Seismic Shard on Yone to slow him and gain Move Speed. Then you can walk up and trade or step away.
Trade while Granite Shield is up, because Thunderclap gives much more Armor then. Let the shield recharge before you trade again.
Hold Unstoppable Force while Yone's Soul Unbound is up and he is far from his body. Knock him up and he snaps back to it.
Use Seismic Shard on Yorick when he walks up to hit minions; it slows him and gives you extra Move Speed to follow up or leave.
Cast Ground Slam when Yorick commits to an attack; it cuts his Attack Speed and weakens his trade.
Hit Yorick with Thunderclap while Granite Shield is up; your Armor is much higher then and his physical hits do little.
Clear Mist Walkers with Ground Slam or Thunderclap before you fight; they die fast and cannot help him if they are gone.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Yorick is out of position; it cannot be stopped mid-dash, and it knocks him up.
Use Ground Slam when Zaahen commits to a fight; it cuts his Attack Speed and slows down his damage.
Hit Zaahen with Seismic Shard to leave him slowed and to gain Move Speed yourself, then walk away from his dash.
Fight when Granite Shield is up, because Thunderclap gives you much more Armor then.
Save Unstoppable Force for when Zaahen is low or pulled in; it knocks him up and cannot be stopped mid-dash.
